maddeler.e:
نشتهر (form VIII)
# نَشْتَهِرُ (naštahiru) /naʃ.ta.hi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَهَرَ (ištahara)
# نَشْتَهِرَ (naštahira) /naʃ.ta.hi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَهَرَ (ištahara)
# نَشْتَهِرْ (naštahir) /naʃ.ta.hir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَهَرَ (ištahara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
